headline: Test 1: Portugal, 1441–1486 · 36:22

items.title: 36:22 · His narrative then collapsed those diverse captives
items.detail: His narrative then collapsed those diverse captives into one degraded category portrayed as living like beasts without law or rational custom.

items.title: 36:30 · Zurara presented violent enslavement and family separation
items.detail: Zurara presented violent enslavement and family separation at Lagos as a pious missionary rescue that brought bodily captives into Christian salvation.

items.title: 36:38 · Check the dates against Prediction 1 and
items.detail: Check the dates against Prediction 1 and Refutation Standard 1: the first kidnapping raid occurred in 1441, the corporate syndicate and Lagos auction occurred in 1444, Dum Diversas was signed in 1452, and Zurara's racial ideology was completed in 1453.

items.title: 36:54 · The commissioned author of the racial hierarchy
items.detail: The commissioned author of the racial hierarchy was an officer of the same Military Order of Christ headed by Prince Henry, the chief financial beneficiary of the royal fifth.

items.title: 37:06 · By 1486 King Joao II completed the
items.detail: By 1486, King Joao II completed the fiscal architecture in Lisbon by establishing the Casa dos Escravos, the state slave-customs house that registered, taxed, and licensed human cargoes entering the realm.
